name: Needledrop
summary: A shop desk for an independent record shop with its own label, showing takings by channel
about: A complete back-office app for a record shop that also runs a small label. Today's takings spin on a drawn record, one coloured groove per channel, as the tonearm drops. There is a till that flips through the crates with drawn sleeves, record stock, mail order with a packing checklist, label pressings and royalties, customer wantlists, in-store gigs and a takings report, in light and dark.
how: Open Counter to watch the record spin up with today's takings by channel, and press Spin again to replay it.
On Till, filter the crates by genre, tap sleeves to pull records, add CRATE10 for 10% off, and take cash, card or wallet.
Add or edit records in Record stock; a new record by a wanted artist raises a wantlist match.
Work through a mail order's packing checklist before marking it packed and handing it to the courier.
On Our label, pay artists the royalties they are owed or order a repress of a release.
Sell gig tickets from Gigs and see them in Takings, where 7D, 30D and 12M redraw the charts.
